theory ListProg

Lists as programs

List programming, symbol tables / environments (EmptyEnv, Extend, Lookup), and higher-order combinators (Foldr, Filter).

Constable et al. §11.2

Lists as a programming theory, following Constable et al. §11.2 (the Nuprl book’s “Lists and Arrays”).

This theory formalizes: 1. Discrete types and decidable equality (`int_discrete`, `unit_discrete`, `list_decide_nil`). 2. Total head with a default and tail operations (`Hd`, `Tl`). 3. Membership (`On`) and context non-repetition (`Unique`) for symbol tables. 4. Environment data structures (association lists) with `EmptyEnv`, `Extend`, and `Lookup` for language interpreters and typecheckers. 5. Higher-order list combinators: `Foldr` and `Filter` with reduction equations.

23 theorems, 12 abstractions, checked by replaying their tactic scripts on the kernel. Hover any piece of syntax for its kind, surface form, and uniform term; open Tactics, Proof, or Analysis to go deeper.

Original source file
-- | Lists as a programming theory, following Constable et al. §11.2
-- (the Nuprl book’s “Lists and Arrays”).
--
-- This theory formalizes:
-- 1. Discrete types and decidable equality (`int_discrete`, `unit_discrete`,
--    `list_decide_nil`).
-- 2. Total head with a default and tail operations (`Hd`, `Tl`).
-- 3. Membership (`On`) and context non-repetition (`Unique`) for symbol tables.
-- 4. Environment data structures (association lists) with `EmptyEnv`, `Extend`,
--    and `Lookup` for language interpreters and typecheckers.
-- 5. Higher-order list combinators: `Foldr` and `Filter` with reduction equations.
theory ListProg

comment book "Constable et al. §11.2: list programming, environments, and higher-order combinators."

abs Discrete(T) == ∀x:T. ∀y:T. x = y ∈ T ∨ ¬(x = y ∈ T)
abs Decidable(T; F) == ∀x:T. F x ∨ ¬(F x)
abs Hd(d; l) == list_ind l (d) (h, t, v. h)
abs Tl(l) == list_ind l ([]) (h, t, v. t)
abs On(e; l; T) == list_ind l False (h, t, v. (e = h ∈ T) ∨ v)
abs Unique(l; T) == list_ind l True (h, t, v. ¬(On(h; t; T)) ∧ v)

-- Environment / symbol-table data structures for interpreters
abs Env(V) == List (Atom × V)
abs EmptyEnv == []
abs Extend(x; v; env) == <x, v> :: env
abs Lookup(d; x; env) ==
  list_ind env (d) (entry, tl, ih.
    atom_eq (let <k, val> = entry in k) x
      (let <k, val> = entry in val)
      ih)

-- Higher-order combinators
abs Foldr(f; z; xs) == list_ind xs (z) (h, t, ih. f h ih)
abs Filter(p; xs) ==
  list_ind xs ([]) (h, t, ih.
    decide (p h) of
      inl u => h :: ih
    | inr v => ih)

soft Discrete, Decidable, Hd, Tl, On, Unique
soft Env, EmptyEnv, Extend, Lookup, Foldr, Filter

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Discreteness and decidability
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

theorem int_discrete :
  Discrete(Int)
proof
  intro x
  intro y
  decide x = y THENL [left THEN hyp, right THEN hyp]
qed

theorem unit_discrete :
  Discrete(Unit)
proof
  intro x
  intro y
  left
  eq
qed

theorem list_decide_nil :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀l:List A. l = [] ∈ List A ∨ ¬(l = [] ∈ List A)
proof
  intro A
  intro l
  elim 2 THENL [
    left THEN eq,
    right THEN intro p THEN elim 6
  ]
qed

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Head with a default and tail
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

theorem hd_nil :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀d:A. Hd(d; []) = d ∈ A
proof
  intro A
  intro d
  eq
qed

theorem hd_cons :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀d:A. ∀h:A. ∀t:List A. Hd(d; h :: t) = h ∈ A
proof
  intro A
  intro d
  intro h
  intro t
  auto
qed

theorem hd_inhab :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀d:A. ∀l:List A. Hd(d; l) ∈ A
proof
  intro A
  intro d
  intro l
  elim 3 THENL [hyp, hyp]
qed

theorem tl_nil :
  ∀A:U{i}. Tl([]) = [] ∈ List A
proof
  intro A
  eq
qed

theorem tl_cons :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀h:A. ∀t:List A. Tl(h :: t) = t ∈ List A
proof
  intro A
  intro h
  intro t
  auto
qed

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Membership (`On`) and Context Non-Repetition (`Unique`)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

theorem on_nil :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀e:A. ¬(On(e; []; A))
proof
  intro A
  intro e
  intro p
  elim 3
qed

theorem on_cons_head :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀e:A. ∀t:List A. On(e; e :: t; A)
proof
  intro A
  intro e
  intro t
  reduce
  left
  eq
qed

theorem on_cons_tail :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀e:A. ∀h:A. ∀t:List A. On(e; t; A) → On(e; h :: t; A)
proof
  intro A
  intro e
  intro h
  intro t
  intro p
  reduce
  right
  hyp
qed

theorem unique_nil :
  ∀A:U{i}. Unique([]; A)
proof
  intro A
  intro
qed

theorem unique_cons :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀h:A. ∀t:List A.
    ¬(On(h; t; A)) → Unique(t; A) → Unique(h :: t; A)
proof
  intro A
  intro h
  intro t
  intro n
  intro u
  reduce
  split THENL [hyp, hyp]
qed

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Environments and Symbol Tables
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

theorem lookup_empty :
  ∀V:U{i}. ∀d:V. ∀x:Atom. Lookup(d; x; EmptyEnv) = d ∈ V
proof
  intro V
  intro d
  intro x
  auto
qed

theorem lookup_hit_token :
  ∀V:U{i}. ∀d:V. ∀v:V. ∀env:Env(V).
    Lookup(d; "x"; Extend("x"; v; env)) = v ∈ V
proof
  intro V
  intro d
  intro v
  intro env
  auto
qed

theorem lookup_concrete :
  Lookup(0; "y"; Extend("x"; 10; Extend("y"; 20; EmptyEnv))) = 20 ∈ Int
proof
  auto
qed

theorem lookup_default :
  Lookup(0; "z"; Extend("x"; 10; Extend("y"; 20; EmptyEnv))) = 0 ∈ Int
proof
  auto
qed

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Higher-Order Combinators: Foldr and Filter
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

theorem foldr_nil :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. ∀f:(A → B → B). ∀z:B.
    Foldr(f; z; []) = z ∈ B
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro f
  intro z
  auto
qed

theorem foldr_cons :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. ∀f:(A → B → B). ∀z:B. ∀x:A. ∀xs:List A.
    Foldr(f; z; x :: xs) = f x (Foldr(f; z; xs)) ∈ B
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro f
  intro z
  intro x
  intro xs
  auto
qed

theorem filter_nil :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀p:(A → (True ⊎ True)).
    Filter(p; []) = [] ∈ List A
proof
  intro A
  intro p
  auto
qed

theorem filter_all :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀x:A. ∀xs:List A.
    Filter((λy. inl Ax); x :: xs) = x :: Filter((λy. inl Ax); xs) ∈ List A
proof
  intro A
  intro x
  intro xs
  auto
qed

theorem filter_none :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀x:A. ∀xs:List A.
    Filter((λy. inr Ax); x :: xs) = Filter((λy. inr Ax); xs) ∈ List A
proof
  intro A
  intro x
  intro xs
  auto
qed

theorem foldr_sum :
  Foldr((λx. λacc. x + acc); 0; [1, 2, 3, 4]) = 10 ∈ Int
proof
  auto
qed
